shortBulletSummary: Hopes for a US-Iran ceasefire extension boosted global equities and saw Bitcoin cross $75,000.
Bitcoin ETFs experienced a record nine consecutive days of outflows totaling $2.8 billion, indicating institutional de-risking.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index registered "Extreme Fear" (23), reflecting deteriorating investor sentiment.
MicroStrategy indicated plans to raise over $80 billion for additional Bitcoin purchases.
A US bill, the "American Reserve Modernisation Act," was introduced to establish a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve.
